IPCC AR6 concludes that recent warming is exceptional in at least the last 2000 years and that the most recent decade exceeds temperatures of the most recent multi-century warm period thousands of years ago; NASA likewise states the long-term modern trend is clearly upward, with about 1°C warming since 1880 that cannot be explained by uncertainty or data error ([NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/earth/climate-change/nope-earth-isnt-cooling/), [IPCC AR6 WGI SPM](https://www.ipcc.ch/report/ar6/wg1/chapter/summary-for-policymakers/)).

   - UNVERIFIABLE: REMOVE — The claim is evaluable using instrumental temperature datasets and paleoclimate reconstructions; it is not intrinsically vague or dependent on inaccessible information.

5. DECISION
   The best label is FALSE. While there was some gradual preindustrial cooling during parts of the late Holocene, the claim says Earth “has been cooling” through the present and has cooled since medieval warming, which is contradicted by modern observations and paleoclimate assessments.
